import unittest

class TestWeatherSystem(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_set_city_with_valid_city(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.set_city('Beijing')
        self.assertEqual(weatherSystem.city, 'Beijing')

    def test_set_city_with_empty_string(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.set_city('')
        self.assertEqual(weatherSystem.city, '')

    def test_set_city_with_none(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.set_city(None)
        self.assertIsNone(weatherSystem.city)

    def test_set_city_with_non_string_type(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            weatherSystem.set_city(123)

if __name__ == '__main__':
